name: filterbar
need: Filter a list from a bar of inline filters that fold into a sheet when narrow, with applied chips, Clear all and a count

--ds-filterbar-gap.description: the gaps of a filter bar at size md and the comfortable density: 4px per size step, 2px per density step

--ds-filterbar-search-min.description: the least width of the bar's search; the filters fold when the row cannot hold it beside them

--ds-filterbar-field-width.description: the width of an inline filter field in the bar (full width in the sheet)

labExempt.DS.filterbar.create: the bar folds and unfolds at once; its chips are input chips and its sheet the side sheet's motion
labExempt.DS.filterbar.read: a pure function of the controls: no motion
labExempt.DS.filterbar.applied: a pure function of the controls: no motion
labExempt.DS.filterbar.fold: the side sheet's own motion (DS.overlay.open), shown in the overlays of the Motion Lab
labExempt.DS.filterbar.filters: the engine of the chips and Clear all: no motion of its own
